technologyCompatibilityAllPlayersTitle: Technology export: compatible with all players
technologyCompatibilityAllPlayersBody: This export includes the Base and relevant DLC research-page placements selected by the project policy.
technologyCompatibilityRequiresDLCBody: This export includes only the research-page placement for the project's required-DLC profile.
technologyAdditiveBody: This P0 export keeps vanilla technologies and adds the project's technology branch to the original research page.
technologyAdditiveFiles: The project technology file and vanilla source file coexist; the GUI is emitted as a minimal same-path patch.
technologyReplacePathNote: replace_path for common/technologies hides the entire vanilla technology directory. It is not a tool for replacing one technology.
riskConfirmBody: Run Check still found {count} unresolved issues. You can export this ZIP, but review the risks before continuing.
riskConfirmImpact: The mod may fail to load, omit authored content, or behave differently from what you intended.
riskConfirmProceed: I understand the risk — export anyway
riskConfirmReminder: This confirms only this export. Run Check will ask again next time.
exportCouldNotComplete: This ZIP could not be built safely. Your project was not changed. Review the details below and try again.
exportTriggered: Export started. The zip is saved to your Downloads folder.
appendToExisting: Append to existing mod (pick base mod zip or folder)
fullPackModeDesc: Treat everything imported from vanilla as your own content, so it exports as part of your mod.
fullPackModeWarning: Only for large total-conversion mods that fully replace vanilla (e.g. Kaiserreich / TNO / OWB). Regular mods don't need it — turning it on bundles all of vanilla into the export zip.
pageSubtitle: Review your project and package it as a HOI4 mod
checksSectionIntro: Three checks: a 30-second quick pre-check, an export safety check, and Mod Health (performance plus your game log). Run them top to bottom, then download below.
step1Desc: A fast first pass: counts what you've built and flags obvious problems. The deep crash-safety check below digs further.
step2FilePreviewBlocked: File preview is paused because serious issues were found. Fix them, or confirm the risks when you export.
step2FilePreviewStale: The replace_path selection changed. Run the quick pre-check again to refresh these results.
validationConsequenceBlocker: This issue may prevent the mod from loading or omit content. We recommend fixing it before export.
identitySubmodDesc: Packages only what you added or changed. Your players enable it on top of the base mod — a small, fast download.
identityStandaloneDesc: Build a standalone mod zip the launcher loads on its own.
identityLoadedDesc: Build one complete standalone package with everything you loaded and everything you built.
identityLoadedUnmodeledNote: The current coverage manifest marks {count} imported path groups as partial or unsupported for standalone reconstruction. Raw files you add explicitly still export as-is.
identityLoadedUnmodeledAction: If the original mod relies on any path listed here, add the required source as a raw file or use Advanced overlay / differential merge to preserve the original archive.
identityAmbiguousTitle: How do you want to export?
identityAmbiguousDesc: This project both depends on a base mod and loaded some base content. Pick which export you want — we won't drop anything silently.
identityAmbiguousDeltaDesc: Small delta · players also enable the base mod. Loaded base content is left out.
identityAmbiguousFullDesc: Complete standalone package · re-emits the base content you loaded alongside your changes.
step3AdvancedExportToggle: Advanced export (overlay onto an existing mod · differential merge)
advancedExportIntro: Only needed if you're merging your edits back into a base mod zip on your machine. Most creators use the one-click export above.
advancedAppendWarning: Overlay / append merges the base mod zip into your export — it can be slow for very large mods. Prefer the one-click export above when you can.
stage8Title: Before you launch: enable the base mod
stage8Intro: This is a submod — it does nothing on its own. You (and every player) must have the base mod installed and loaded first:
stage8UnregisteredNote: Find "{dependency}" in the launcher or Steam Workshop and enable it.
stage8Step2: In the launcher's playset, put the base mod ABOVE your submod (base loads first, yours second).
closureLaunchHint: Opens Steam and the Paradox launcher — enable your mod there and adjust the load order.
noContentHint: Create some characters / focus nodes / technologies first, then run the check again.
hasErrorsHint: Validation has errors. You can still download but the mod may fail to load.
includeImportedLabel: Include imported content in the zip
includeImportedTitleOn: ON · imported decisions / ideas / focus / tech / events will be included in the standalone zip.
includeImportedTitleOff: OFF · only entities you created in the program are exported · imported content is dropped from the standalone zip.
validationRequestFailed: The project check is temporarily unavailable. Try again; your project has not been changed.
overrideSectionDanger: Choose vanilla directories this mod must completely take over. Any vanilla content in those directories that you do not provide again will disappear from the campaign.
overrideCrossLink: Only replacing one file at the same path? Use Raw export files above. Take over a whole directory only when this mod provides everything in it.
overrideReplacePathDesc: A checked directory takes over the matching vanilla folder in full. Any vanilla content you do not provide again disappears; this notice does not claim to resolve another mod's load order.
overrideWorldDanger: Selecting these removes the matching vanilla directories. Countries or states the author has not defined may disappear from the starting world.
rawFilesDesc: Add text or binary files at any mod-relative path. They're written byte-for-byte and work in standalone projects too. In a submod, a same-path file overrides its dependency. Raw content isn't parsed or validated, so it's on you to get it right.
rawFileTlarHint: Use a template for a supported starting point, or paste the complete source file. For a same-path override, start from the real dependency file and change only what you intend to replace.
rawFileContentPlaceholder: Paste the WHOLE forked base-mod file here, with the lines you want gone deleted.
rawFileGenReplacePath: Also add replace_path for this file's directory (rarely needed — same-name override alone usually suffices; this shadows the ENTIRE base directory, so you'd have to re-ship its other files).
rawFileNotePlaceholder: e.g. forked from TNO, deleted reich.23 day=653
rawFileBinaryDesc: Upload a binary file (DDS / PNG / .ogg) to override a base-mod file at the same path. The bytes ship verbatim — correctness is yours. They can't be edited here; to change them, delete and re-upload.
rawFileBinaryNoFile: Choose a file to upload first.
rawFileTemplateDesc: Generate a starting-point scripted_gui 'variable overview' panel (a .gui + scripted_gui pair). STARTING POINT — verify positions/sprites in-game and gate visibility to your country.
rawFileTemplateVarsLabel: Variables — one per line: variable_key  Label
rawFileTemplatePickerSubtitle: Pick a domain to generate a starting file that exports as-is.
rawFileTemplateKeyGenericHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores — it becomes part of the file name.
rawFileTemplateKeyInvalid: Naming prefix must be 2-40 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores.
rawFileTemplateListFailed: Could not load the template list — you can still add files manually below.
rawFileEmptyShadowDesc: Create a zero-byte file at one exact path. This is not replace_path and never hides a whole directory.
rawFileEmptyShadowEvidenceWarning: Advanced and fail-closed: this requires an exact project game version plus a verified source layer and SHA-256 allowlist entry. The bundled 1.19.2 policy is not verified yet, so the API will reject requests until real-game evidence is approved.
rawFileEmptyShadowEvidenceRequired: Enter the exact path, source layer, and 64-character SHA-256.

repair.pageIntro: Work through what the export check suggested, one item at a time. Fixing is optional — the download stays available on the export page.
repair.originSub: Fixing is optional; the download is always available on the export page

repair.panelWhereUnknown: The check did not name a location

repair.panelOpenDialogHint: Opens the settings dialog on this page — the repair queue stays put.

repair.panelNoRouteBody: The check did not point at specific content, so we cannot open a workbench for it. Use the hint above to handle it yourself; leaving it alone and downloading is fine too.

repair.panelResolved: This item passed the re-check. Move on to the next one.

repair.doneBody: Every item in the queue passed the re-check. Head back to export and download the latest ZIP.
repair.emptyBody: This check suggested nothing to fix. Head back to export and download whenever you like.

repair.loadFailedBody: This does not affect the download — grab the ZIP from the export page and come back later.
